description: Read a subject's reviews: subject is its id or TYPE:KEY. Returns its owners, the lab assessment (the newest lab review whose full record recomputes with the rubric: score, band, grade, flags) and lab_runs (the rest are self-reported), other raters (republished outside figures, never blended), and the community reviews in the default order, each with its weight and parts, evidence states, reply count (comments live in its thread, data.reviews[].thread) and the owner's pinned reply; data.aggregate counts them. Reviews of an earlier version of an offering are in earlier_version_reviews, labelled, never counted. Page with next_cursor.
name: read_subject
title: Read subject
